pick.headline: Tanks deployed against Belgrade protests
pick.summary: On March 9, 1991, opposition demonstrators led by Vuk Draskovic clashed with police in Belgrade, and the Yugoslav army deployed tanks in the city.
pick.significance: The protests were the strongest challenge to Slobodan Milosevic before the wars began that summer.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 047, 11 March 1991
evidence.snippet: …The opposition demands that the Serbian legislature ban Serbia’s ruling Socialist Party of Serbia (SPS) and the League of Communists-Movement for Yugoslavia from carrying out the personnel and editorial policies of the Belgrade television. According to the Belgrade television, Slobodan Milosevic accepted to receive an SPO legislative group when his duties permitted him to do so.
